Mitsubishi UFJ Trust & Banking Corp decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.0% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Apple makes up 3.0% of Mitsubishi UFJ Trust & Banking Corp’s portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. Mitsubishi UFJ Trust & Banking Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,645,013,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
